page.layout: One page of text, with a Hebrew epigraph block at the top beside the Latin continuation; below it a heading "NOTÆ." and a block of notes in full width; a catchword at the lower right. No margin notes beyond the text block.

main_text.p: duis conclavis num-mis. Abba Saul dicit, summos pontifices gradus vaccæ & hirci proprio sumptu conficere.
main_text.head: NOTÆ.
main_text.p: (1) De sacrificio iugi vid. 556. (2) Quid ספיחין vid. 295. (3) In anno lubilæo aut septimo omnes fructus erant הפקר communes; & tamen Omer & duo panes debebant ex frugibus novis offerri: idcirco Synedrium aliquos custodes creavit, recipientes mercedem suam ex conclavi, ut certam partem frugum custodirent, ex quibus Omer & duo panes deinde offerri possent; sic Maymon cap. 4. Schekal. (4) alius etiam sensus esse potest verbi מתנדב, & sæpius de spontanea oblatione intelligitur, sed nos Maymonid. sequuti sumus. (5) De vacca Rufa vid. pag. (6) De hirco emissario vid. pag. 185. & seq. (7) De lingua coccinea vid. pag. 185. quid illa fuerit docet Glossa; לשון של זהוריה צמר צבוע כשני תולעת; Lefchon Sehorit est lana murice coccineoque colore tincta. (8) vid. Kedron pag. 314. (9) Tum canales quibus aqua in templum devehebatur, tum ille qui in ipsa urbe. (10) Postquàm ille qui conclave ingressus tres ciftas plenas implevit, ficli qui in ciftis vocantur תרומת Truma conclavis. וה שישאר שם יותר על מה שיש בקופות הוא הנקרא שירי הלשכה; Illi verò qui praterea adhuc in conclavi sunt excepti illis qui sunt in ciftis, vocantur residuum conclavis. Maymon Schekal. cap. 2.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-looking characters in the epigraph and notes are transcribed as far as legible; the Hebrew lines at the top were partly illegible in places. Shelf marks and stains omitted.
